notes: Event monitors record time of last rising clock / falling reset edge per domain and count output changes not coinciding with one (or repeated within a time step). The assertions check the counters are stable at each clock edge. Two assertions are used, one per domain, both sharing counter CHK_002. Caveat: hits_CHK_002 is written from two always_ff blocks on different clocks, which Verilator may flag as multi-driven (MULTIDRIVEN). If that is a problem, split it into hits_CHK_002_slv, though the final block only prints hits_CHK_002.
